overview.title: Bank workspace
overview.description: Scoped to {bank}. Corporate data is shown only where your bank role permits it.
overview.noApprovals: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
overview.workerNever: No worker heartbeat recorded. Start the worker to process payments.

corporates.title: Corporates
corporates.description: Corporates of your bank and the status of their service agreements.
corporates.empty: No corporates in your bank scope.

agreement.title: Agreement — {corporate}
agreement.noVersion: No approved revision yet. Operational services stay off until a signed revision is approved by a second bank administrator.
agreement.pendingTitle: A revision is awaiting an independent bank approval
agreement.pendingBody: Proposed by {maker}. It can be reviewed by a bank admin checker who did not propose it.
agreement.suspendBody: New submissions and releases for this corporate are blocked immediately. Restoring requires an approval from a second bank administrator.
agreement.restorePending: A restore proposal is awaiting independent approval.
agreement.cannotPropose: Your role can view agreements but not propose changes.

editor.title: Propose agreement revision
editor.description: A full, immutable revision. Nothing takes effect until a different bank administrator approves it.
editor.templateNote: Starting values come from the {segment} demo template or the current revision. They are synthetic test policy, not CBL or bank-approved limits.
editor.signatureNote: No e-signature service is connected. The evidence reference and its digest are recorded as a simulated attestation.
editor.unavailable: Not available in this release — cannot be enabled
editor.submitted: Revision proposed. A different bank administrator must approve it.

diff.title: Changes compared with revision {version}
diff.titleFirst: First revision — all terms are new
diff.none: No differences from the current revision.

rails.title: Rail parameters
rails.description: Simulated rail ceilings, cut-offs and calendars. None of these values is a confirmed CBL figure; a rail without a ceiling cannot be used.
rails.ceilingHint: Leave empty to mark the ceiling as not configured: the rail is then blocked.
rails.cannotPropose: Your role can view rail parameters but not propose changes.

approvals.title: Governance approvals
approvals.description: Agreement revisions, rail parameters and repair proposals. The proposer can never approve their own proposal.
